execution_integrity_failure.rule: If runtime/provenance/trace/artifact/hash/truth-boundary validation fails, V7 is an invalid execution rather than a scientific negative result. The workflow must fail closed and no V7 claim level may be assigned.

mapping_precedence.when: either observer-arm removal strictly dominates full V6, or max TV exceeds 0.25
mapping_precedence.interpretation: no superior dual-allocation claim; retain contradiction-guided diagnostic methodology at most

mapping_precedence.when: max TV <= 0.25 and V6 mean joint ratio <= 1.0
max TV <= 0.25, V6 mean joint ratio > 1.0, and failure is a regime joint-ratio floor or legacy worst-joint superiority rule
mapping_precedence.interpretation: conditional allocation benefit without full robustness

mapping_precedence.when: any remaining valid-execution failure pattern not captured above
mapping_precedence.interpretation: diagnostic/negative locked validation; no allocator-superiority claim

non_rules: Observer complementarity disappearance is not assigned a separate claim level because V7 has no preregistered quantitative complementarity threshold.
A provenance or reproducibility failure is not claim level E; it invalidates the V7 execution and produces no scientific claim.
V7 scientific failure must never be repaired by changing V6 weights, adding disagreement quota, changing thresholds or editing this mapping within the same generation.
